description:
The anticipated IDIQ contract will require contractors to:
• Procure residential standby generators in accordance with Government
technical specifications.
• Procure compatible Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS).
• Procure required accessories and ancillary components.
• Prepare equipment for export and international shipment.
• Coordinate freight forwarding services.
• Provide export documentation and commercial shipping documentation.
• Deliver equipment to designated domestic or overseas U.S. Government
locations.
This requirement is strictly limited to procurement and shipment.
Installation, commissioning, inspection, and testing services are NOT included
under this anticipated requirement.
